newsitem.title: PERU: Miners spur Lima stock market to higher close.
newsitem.headline: Miners spur Lima stock market to higher close.

text.p: Market players jumped into mining stocks Friday, pushing up the Lima Stock Exchange as traders said the momentum should continue into Monday.
The blue-chip index closed up 0.50 percent at 2,595.46 points, while the general index closed 0.83 percent higher at 1,791.27 points.
Market attention was focused firmly on mining stocks, whose sector has seen a bullish performance since the start of the year, with a rise of 85.7 percent so far.
The bolsa's heaviest-traded stock, mining company Atacocha, rallied to close up 6.8 percent at 1.57 soles, with over 1.5 million of its shares traded.
Elsewhere in the sector, Buenaventura's labor shares closed up 1.15 percent at 22 soles, but volume was a thin 6,183.
Telecom giant and Lima benchmark Telefonica de Peru "B" also saw heavy trading, closing up 0.31 percent at 6.44 soles, with over 1.2 million shares traded.
Elsewhere, Peru's brewery group, Union de Cervecerias Backus y Johnston, closed up 1.56 percent at 1.95 soles, with 1.1 million shares traded.
